possible_model_blind_spots.finding: Loading can affect onset much more than completion, as in m51, or change completion direction across ratios, as in m74. A molecular offset or common endpoint shift cannot represent both.

Increasing EA generally strengthens silica elution. Hydrogen-bond accessibility, carbonyl environment, ether topology and basic or charged sites can affect silica interaction. These priors do not establish monotonic endpoint curves or explain measured reversals.
Adsorption saturation, injection focusing, solubility and omitted run or integration variation remain competing explanations. The supplied labels do not identify the operative mechanism.
